relevant_laws.quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: On the highway side of any vehicle stopped or parked at the edge of or curb of a highway.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: direct highway-side stop, stand or park restriction
relevant_laws.notes: Actual highway-side relation, activity and exceptions require original review.
